name: SEInc Backup
author: SEO Baked

sections.description:
SEInc Backup is a powerful and user-friendly solution for WordPress backup. This plugin allows you to create full backups of your WordPress installation, including the database, themes, plugins, and uploads to custom folder within you hosting account.

Key features:

  • Select backup folder path (We recommend selecting folder path outside the WordPress installation directory.)
  • Manual backup creation
  • Easy to download
  • Delete backup

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher / MariaDB 10.1 or higher
sections.installation:
WordPress Admin Method

  1. Upload the seinc-backup.zip folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

  3. Navigate to ‘Settings’ > ‘SEInc Backup’ to configure the plugin

FTP Activation Method

  1. Download plugin and Unzip the seinc-backup.zip folder.

  2. Upload the complete seinc-backup folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory

  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
How often should I backup my site?

We recommend creating a full backup at least once a week, with more frequent backups for sites that update content regularly.

Where are the backups stored?

Backups are stored in the selected directory of your hosting account that you configure in the settings.

Can I download backup files to my computer?

Yes, you can download your backup files as filename.zip on your local computer folder.
